description: Poll a brief submitted with run_brief. While it runs you get its status and progress; when it finishes you get the cover note, a summary table, the delivered profile cards with their commit links and screening questions, the screening leads with the reason each was not delivered, the coverage statement and a reproducible run manifest. status "partial" means a ceiling was hit, so report the regions actually covered rather than claiming exhaustive coverage. Costs 0 monthly credits.
name: get_brief
title: Get a sourcing brief
